nodes.label: Root forwards runtime inputs
nodes.contract: Root forwards agencyOperatorSession, culturalHeritageRecords to the next component on composition_path.

nodes.label: ETOUR connection interruption rollback rule
nodes.contract: Idempotent interruption rollback rule for the confirmed CulturalHeritage deletion: it is invoked with culturalHeritageId, the operator confirmation and the etourConnectionInterrupted observation that the request boundary produced from its completed outbound idempotent DELETE to the ETOUR CulturalHeritage service. The rule uses the same culturalHeritageId-derived key as the boundary's deletion attempt. When etourConnectionInterrupted is true it reconciles the ETOUR-side attempt under that key, drives the attempt and the local persistence transaction to the not-committed state so the selected CulturalHeritage remains unchanged at the ETOUR boundary and in the store, produces no success notification, and reports the interruption failure for a safe idempotent retry. When etourConnectionInterrupted is false the confirmed deletion proceeds and commits.

nodes.label: CulturalHeritage deletion cancellation confirmation on the confirmation dialog
nodes.contract: Alternative path where the Agency Operator confirms cancellation of the CulturalHeritage deletion while the elimination confirmation dialog is open: input controls are blocked while the cancellation is handled, the deletion request is never dispatched, the selected cultural heritage stays unchanged, the cancellation confirmation is shown, controls are re-enabled and no deletion-success notification appears.

nodes.label: DELETE CulturalHeritage request boundary
nodes.contract: Authenticated request boundary for the Agency Operator's confirmed elimination of one selected CulturalHeritage; rejects the request without deleting anything when the explicit confirmation is not present, and otherwise returns 204 after the deletion succeeds.

nodes.label: CulturalHeritage deletion interruption rollback persistence
nodes.contract: Transaction-bound persistence for an interrupted confirmed CulturalHeritage deletion: deleteCulturalHeritageRecord is called with the selected culturalHeritageId and the etourConnectionInterrupted observation. It opens an explicit database transaction keyed by culturalHeritageId. When etourConnectionInterrupted is true the adapter performs no delete or rolls back the staged delete, leaves the CulturalHeritage record unchanged and returns the interruption failure; when false it deletes the CulturalHeritage and commits. No success state is persisted for an interrupted deletion.

nodes.label: Cancellation rule that cancels the CulturalHeritage deletion before the request is dispatched
nodes.contract: When the Agency Operator confirms cancellation while the elimination confirmation dialog for the selected CulturalHeritage is open, the deletion request is never dispatched, the selected CulturalHeritage stays unchanged, input controls stay blocked until the cancellation is handled and are then re-enabled, and only a cancellation confirmation is produced with no deletion-success notification.

nodes.label: Interrupted CulturalHeritage deletion request boundary
nodes.contract: Idempotent request boundary for a confirmed CulturalHeritage deletion: the boundary issues the confirmed deletion to the ETOUR CulturalHeritage service as an outbound idempotent DELETE keyed by culturalHeritageId and synchronously observes its outcome to produce etourConnectionInterrupted. When the connection is interrupted before the deletion commits, the boundary reconciles the same attempt under that key and invokes the deletion rule under the same key, so the ETOUR-side attempt and the local persistence transaction resolve together, the selected CulturalHeritage remains unchanged at the ETOUR boundary and in the persistence store, no success is reported, and the Agency Operator can retry idempotently; it returns 503 with that failure. When the Agency Operator is not logged in it returns 401.

nodes.label: AppShell forwards runtime inputs
nodes.contract: AppShell forwards agencyOperatorSession, culturalHeritageRecords to the next component on composition_path.

nodes.label: Confirmation-gated CulturalHeritage elimination rule
nodes.contract: Applies deletion of the selected CulturalHeritage only after the Agency Operator has explicitly confirmed the operation; without that confirmation the operation is rejected and no cultural choice is removed.

nodes.label: CulturalHeritage deletion screen with confirmation dialog and success notice
nodes.contract: Screen where the Agency Operator views the CulturalHeritage list, selects a cultural heritage, activates elimination, confirms the operation, and then sees the deleted item gone from the list with a notice of the successful elimination.

nodes.label: CulturalHeritage deletion connection-interruption error on the confirmation dialog
nodes.contract: Exception projection on the CulturalHeritage deletion confirmation dialog: when the connection to the ETOUR server is interrupted before the confirmed deletion completes, the deletion is treated as failed, the selected cultural heritage stays unchanged and listed, no success notification is shown, and the dialog alert region informs the Agency Operator that the connection was interrupted so the confirmed operation can be retried.

nodes.label: CulturalHeritage record deletion persistence
nodes.contract: Deletes the single CulturalHeritage record identified by culturalHeritageId from persistent storage and reports whether one record was removed.
